commits.subject: net: TWinIocp did call closesocket() twice on Unsubscribe with a pending wieRecv
commits.body:
mormot.net.async posts a zero-byte wieRecv ('next') after each ProcessRead.
If the server closes the connection afterwards, Unsubscribe() posts a second
wieRecv ('unsub') on the same subscription. When the client closes, both
complete, and two worker threads may call closesocket() + fOne.Free() at the
same time. If Windows already reused the handle for a new connection, the
second closesocket() closes this unrelated connection.

TWinIocpSubscription now counts its pending overlapped operations: closesocket()
and Free() happen on the very last completion only. Unsubscribe() holds its own
reference meanwhile.

commits.subject: core: TFileStreamEx.CreateWrite aShareMode is an integer, not a cardinal
commits.body:
#796 made CreateWrite(aFileName, aShareMode: cardinal) distinct from
CreateRead(aFileName), but the new signature then matched
Create(aFileName, Mode: cardinal) instead, so Delphi still reports W1029
for TFileStreamEx.CreateWrite when the unit is compiled into a package.

aShareMode is now an integer, the same type as the aMode parameter of
FileOpen() and FileCreate() it is passed to. Callers are unaffected, and
the fmShare* constants fit both types.
